title: Four, Five, and the Article Hiding in Eins
label: ch:ge-zahlen-4-5
canDo: I can count to five in German, run the whole five as one motion, and use ein and eine for “a”.

payoff.summary: Four and five complete the first run, which is then said as one motion rather than five remembered words. The chapter closes on ein / eine: the counting form eins with its -s taken off, exactly as English a and an are one worn down.
